Name: Food Poisoning
Author: seferonipepperoni
Description:
[left][color=#d8d8d8][b][size=6]Overview[/size][/b][/color][/left]
[size=4]This mod intends to provide a fairly minimalist implementation of a food poisoning mechanic in order to encourage and empower cooking and cooked consumables. The intent is, ultimately, conducive to a higher difficulty of play, especially in the early game. Current (v1.1.0) functionality includes:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]application of the "Nauseated" debuff upon consumption of a[b] raw [/b]food item ([b]excluding fruit, cooked food items and artisan goods[/b]). This debuff functions essentially identical as vanilla, preventing players from consuming further food for the duration of its uptime (by default, two real-time minutes).[/size]
[/list] ﻿[list]
[*][size=4]differentiation between "[b]Harmful[/b]" and conventional raw food items. By default, food items that have Edibility values below 0 (that is, [b]food items that damage health and/or stamina[/b]) are considered by Food Poisoning as Harmful. Harmful food items have a higher base chance of causing the Nauseated debuff (configurable) and may extend its duration (configurable).[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]The Nauseated debuff applied by Food Poisoning can also be [b]cured by the consumption of ginger.
[/b][/size] ﻿ ﻿
[color=#d8d8d8][size=6][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]
This mod has integrated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]support. Options include:
﻿
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]the base food poisoning chance, evaluated whenever a raw food item is consumed,[/size]
[/list] ﻿ [list]
[*][size=4]the base duration of the Nauseated debuff, in seconds,[/size]
[/list] ﻿ [list]
[*][size=4]the Edibility threshold below which a food item is considered Harmful,[/size]
[/list] ﻿ [list]
[*][size=4]the added chance for food poisoning when consuming Harmful food items,[/size]
[/list] ﻿ [list]
[*][size=4]and the added duration, in seconds, for food poisoning when consuming Harmful food items.[/size]
[/list] ﻿
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
[b][color=#cccccc][size=6]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
﻿
[size=4]Unzip the archive into Stardew Valley\Mods.[/size]
[center]﻿[/center][left]﻿[color=#d8d8d8][size=6][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[size=4][b]This mod requires SMAPI v4.0.0 (and newer). [/b]Older versions may work, but are unsupported.
